title: When the Compass Turns
author: Juniper Iversen
blurb: Felix Nakamura, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
